text:
maria: Heads up — master CI started failing after the gcc toolchain bump (rolled this morning). Multiple x86_64-linux shards show linker errors (undefined references) on a bunch of C++ binaries. Anyone already digging?

maria: failing target example: `//runtime/server:inference_server_bin`

maria: excerpt from shard-12 log:
```
/usr/bin/ld: .libs/libruntime.a(server.o): in function `Worker::start()':
server.o:(.text+0x1a2b): undefined reference to `__atomic_fetch_add_8'
/usr/bin/ld: server.o: in function `init_globals()':
server.o:(.text+0x2b10): undefined reference to `__atomic_load_8'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

alex: hmm, that looks like missing libatomic symbols — did the toolchain switch change default linker flags or libc++/libstdc++?

devon: @maria can you paste the full `bazel build` command used by CI or point to the shard log link? i want to reproduce locally. :eyes:

maria: CI uses `bazel build --config=opt --copt=-march=x86-64 --jobs=200 //...` (we pass cc_toolchain top-level). Link to shard: http://ci.internal/shards/12 (private)

sam: quick sanity: try adding `linkopts: ["-latomic"]` to the cc_binary that fails to see if it's just a missing lib. if that fixes it, we can decide a temporary pin or system patch.

alex: also check if the toolchain's `gcc` now emits `-latomic` differently for 64-bit. We saw similar with arm64 earlier where atomics moved into libgcc vs libatomic.

maria: i repro'ed locally with the same bazel config and confirmed same undefined refs. Patching `BUILD` with `linkopts` gets past link.

build-cop: request: can someone run a quick bisect to see which commit in the toolchain roll introduced the change? we need an anchor for policy (revert vs patch).

devon: i can bisect tomorrow morning (UTC) unless someone else wants it now. does the roll include gcc, binutils, or a libc bump? logs show gcc 13.1.0 and libstdc++ 2024-02.

maria: creating a temporary PR that applies `linkopts = ["-latomic"]` on the failing targets and a separate one to pin the toolchain to yesterday's image for Dedicated nightly.

alex: SGTM. if bisect points to gcc's change we should open an infra ticket to coordinate with toolchain team instead of mass patching BUILD files.

sam: quick workaround +1. Can CI rerun with --spawn_strategy=local to confirm not a remote cache artifact?

ci-bot: @maria triggered rebuild of shard-12 with `--sandbox_debug --spawn_strategy=local`. Queue ID: q-48291. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks, will watch. if CI passes with local spawn then maybe remote linker image is inconsistent. if it fails, we keep the linkopts PR.

devon: note for bisect: if it's atomic symbols moving between libgcc/libatomic, we might need to update toolchain `linker_flag` templates. i'll collect failures and narrow down commits.

alex: pinging @toolchain-team (not in this channel) to flag potential regression.

maria: ok closing loop — will update thread with bisect result or PR number. thx all :thumbsup:
